summary: BioMar is committing 100 million in capital investment to electrify its Myre production facility as part of efforts to reduce its environmental footprint. The project reflects the aquaculture feed producer's sustainability focus and operational modernization strategy.
title: BioMar investerer 100 millioner på Myre. Vil redusere fotavtrykket ved å elektrifisere driften
